meta.title: Scripts & alphabets
meta.subtitle: 22 writing systems, from Cyrillic to Hangul

items.name: Arabic

sample.text: يولد جميع الناس أحرارًا متساوين في الكرامة والحقوق. وقد وهبوا عقلاً وضميرًا وعليهم أن يعامل بعضهم بعضًا بروح…

tells: Right-to-left, letters joined in a flowing line
Many dots above and below letters
Used for Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Pashto
facts: Kurdish, Arabic, Persian, Dari, Pashto, Urdu
items.blurb: The Arabic script is the writing system used for Arabic and several other languages of Asia and Africa.

items.name: Armenian

sample.text: Բոլոր մարդիկ ծնվում են ազատ ու հավասար իրենց արժանապատվությամբ ու իրավունքներով։ Նրանք ունեն բանականություն…

tells: Hook-shaped letters like ո, ւ, ն, մ
Looks like rounded Latin letters with tails
Capital and small letters
items.blurb: The Armenian alphabet or, more broadly, the Armenian script, is an alphabetic writing system developed for Armenian and occasionally used to write other languages. It was developed around 405 AD by Mesrop Mashtots, an Armenian linguist and ecclesiastical leader.

items.name: Bengali

sample.text: সমস্ত মানুষ স্বাধীনভাবে সমান মর্যাদা এবং অধিকার নিয়ে জন্মগ্রহণ করে।

tells: Headline bar like Devanagari, but with triangular, pointed letters
Letters like ক, ব, স, র
Used for Bengali and Assamese
items.blurb: The Bengali–Assamese script, sometimes also known as Eastern Nagri, is an eastern Brahmic script primarily used today for the Bengali and Assamese languages spoken in eastern South Asia. It evolved from Gaudi script, also the common ancestor of the Odia and Tirhuta scripts.

items.name: Burmese (Myanmar)

sample.text: လူတိုင်းသည် တူညီ လွတ်လပ်သော ဂုဏ်သိက္ခာဖြင့် လည်းကောင်း၊…

tells: Letters made almost entirely of circles and arcs
Very few straight lines
Sentence mark ။
items.blurb: The Burmese alphabet is an abugida used for writing Burmese, based on the Mon–Burmese script. It is ultimately adapted from a Brahmic script, either the Kadamba or Pallava alphabet of South India.

items.name: Chinese characters

sample.text: 人人生而自由，在尊严和权利上一律平等。他们赋有理性和良心，并应以兄弟关系的精神相对待。

tells: Thousands of square, complex characters
No alphabet and no spaces
Also used (as kanji) in Japanese
items.blurb: Chinese characters are logographs used to write the Chinese languages and others from regions historically influenced by Chinese culture, including Japan, Korea, and Vietnam.

items.name: Cyrillic

sample.text: Все люди рождаются свободными и равными в своем достоинстве и правах.

tells: Some Latin look-alikes with different sounds: В, Н, Р, С
Letters Latin doesn't have: Ж, Ш, Щ, Я, Ю, Ы
Capital and small letters
facts: Serbian, Bosnian, Montenegrin, Macedonian, Bulgarian, Russian +7 more
items.blurb: The Cyrillic script is a writing system used for various languages across Eurasia.

items.name: Devanagari

sample.text: सभी मनुष्यों को गौरव और अधिकारों के मामले में जन्मजात स्वतन्त्रता और समानता प्राप्त है ।

tells: A continuous headline bar along the top of words
Vertical stroke । as a full stop
Used for Hindi, Nepali and Marathi
items.blurb: Devanagari is an Indic script used in the Indian subcontinent. Also simply called Nāgarī, it is a left-to-right abugida, based on the ancient Brāhmī script.

items.name: Ge'ez (Ethiopic)

sample.text: የሰው፡ልጅ፡ሁሉ፡ሲወለድ፡ነጻና፡በክብርና፡በመብትም፡እኩልነት፡ያለው፡ነው።፡የተፈጥሮ፡ማስተዋልና፡ሕሊና፡ስላለው፡አንዱ፡ሌላውን፡በወንድማማችነት፡መንፈስ፡መመልከት፡ይገባዋል።

tells: Each symbol is a whole syllable
Letters with little "feet", rings and tails
Word separator ፡
items.blurb: Geʽez is an abugida used to write several Afro-Asiatic and Nilo-Saharan languages of Ethiopia and Eritrea.

items.name: Georgian

sample.text: ყოველი ადამიანი იბადება თავისუფალი და თანასწორი თავისი ღირსებითა და უფლებებით.

tells: Round, curly letters with loops and tails
No capital letters
Unique to Georgia
items.blurb: The Georgian scripts are the three writing systems used to write the Georgian language: Asomtavruli, Nuskhuri and Mkhedruli. Although the systems differ in appearance, their letters share the same names and alphabetical order and are written horizontally from left to right.

items.name: Greek

sample.text: Όλοι οι άνθρωποι γεννιούνται ελεύθεροι και ίσοι στην αξιοπρέπεια και τα δικαιώματα.

tells: α, β, γ, δ, λ, π, σ, ω — the letters from maths and physics
Final sigma ς
Accent marks on vowels
items.blurb: The Greek alphabet has been used to write the Greek language since the late 9th or early 8th century BC. It was derived from the earlier Phoenician alphabet, and is the earliest known alphabetic script to systematically write vowels as well as consonants.

items.name: Hangul

sample.text: 모든 인간은 태어날 때부터 자유로우며 그 존엄과 권리에 있어 동등하다. 인간은 천부적으로 이성과 양심을 부여받았으며 서로 형제애의 정신으로 행동하여야 한다.

tells: Letters grouped into square syllable blocks
Lots of circles (ㅇ) and short straight lines
Spaces between words
items.blurb: The Korean alphabet is the modern writing system for the Korean language. It has gone by a variety of names, such as Chosŏn'gŭl in North Korea, Hangul internationally, and Hangeul in South Korea.

items.name: Hebrew

sample.text: כל בני אדם נולדו בני חורין ושווים בערכם ובזכויותיהם. כולם חוננו בתבונה ובמצפון, לפיכך חובה עליהם לנהוג איש…

tells: Right-to-left, square letters that don't join
Letters like א, ש, ם
Special final forms at word ends
items.blurb: The Hebrew alphabet or aleph-bet, known variously by scholars as the Ktav Ashuri, Jewish script, square script and block script, is a unicameral abjad script used in the writing of the Hebrew language.

items.name: Japanese kana

sample.text: すべての人間は、生まれながらにして自由であり、かつ、尊厳と権利とについて平等である。人間は、理性と良心とを授けられており…

tells: Simple curvy syllables (hiragana: の, は, を) mixed with Chinese characters
Angular katakana (ア, カ, ン) for foreign words
No spaces between words
items.blurb: Kana are syllabaries used to write Japanese phonological units, morae. In current usage, kana most commonly refers to hiragana and katakana.

items.name: Khmer

sample.text: មនុស្សទាំងអស់ កើតមកមានសេរីភាព និងសមភាព…

tells: Ornate letters with small hooks and "hats" on top
Consonants stacked below others
Long runs without spaces
items.blurb: Khmer script is an abugida script used to write the Khmer language, the official language of Cambodia. It is also used to write Pali in the Buddhist liturgy of Cambodia and Thailand.

items.name: Lao

sample.text: ມະນຸດເກີດມາມີສິດເສລີພາບ ແລະ ສະເໝີໜ້າກັນໃນທາງກຽດຕິສັກ ແລະ…

tells: Like Thai but rounder and with fewer loops
No spaces between words
Letters like ກ, ລ, ວ
items.blurb: Lao script or Akson Lao is the primary script used to write the Lao language and other languages in Laos. Its earlier form, the Tai Noi script, was also used to write the Isan language, but was replaced by the Thai script.

items.name: Latin

sample.text: Semua orang dilahirkan merdeka dan mempunyai martabat dan hak-hak yang sama.

tells: The ABC letters used for English and most of Europe, the Americas and Africa
Diacritics (é, ñ, ø) vary by language
Capital and small letters
facts: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian +66 more
items.blurb: The Latin script, also known as the Roman script, is a writing system based on the letters of the classical Latin alphabet, derived from a form of the Greek alphabet used in the ancient Greek city of Cumae in Magna Graecia.

items.name: Sinhala

sample.text: සියලු මනුෂ්‍යයෝ නිදහස්ව උපත ලබා ඇත. ගරුත්වයෙන් හා අයිතිවාසිකම්වලින් සමාන වෙති.

tells: Round, curly letters made of loops
No headline bar
Distinctive swirling vowel signs
items.blurb: The Sinhalese script, also known as Sinhala script, is a writing system used by the Sinhalese people and most Sri Lankans in Sri Lanka and elsewhere to write the Sinhalese language as well as the liturgical languages Pali and Sanskrit.

items.name: Tamil

sample.text: மனிதப் பிறிவியினர் சகலரும் சுதந்திரமாகவே பிறக்கின்றனர்; அவர்கள் மதிப்பிலும், உரிமைகளிலும் சமமானவர்கள்…

tells: No headline bar; rounded but angular letters
Dots (pulli) on top of many letters
Letters like ம, ன, ழ
items.blurb: The Tamil script is an abugida script that is used by Tamils and Tamil speakers in India, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Singapore and elsewhere to write the Tamil language. It is one of the official scripts of the Indian Republic.

items.name: Thaana

sample.text: ހުރިހާ އިންސާނުންވެސް ދުނިޔެއަށް އުފަންވަނީ، މިނިވަންކަމުގައި، ހަމަހަމަ ޙައްޤުތަކަކާއެކު، ހަމަހަމަ…

tells: Right-to-left, short slanted hook letters
A vowel mark on every consonant
Letters don't join (unlike Arabic)
items.blurb: Thaana, Tãna, Taana or Tāna is the writing system of the Maldivian language spoken in the Maldives.

items.name: Thai

sample.text: มนุษย์ทั้งหลายเกิดมามีอิสระและเสมอภาคกันในเกียรติศักดิ์และสิ…

tells: Little loops at the start of most letters
No spaces between words
Tone marks stacked above letters
items.blurb: The Thai script is the abugida used to write Thai, Southern Thai and many other languages spoken in Thailand. The Thai script itself has 44 consonant symbols, 16 vowel symbols that combine into at least 32 vowel forms, four tone diacritics, and other diacritics.

items.name: Tibetan

sample.text: འགྲོ་བ་མི་ཚུ་ག་ར་དལ་དབང་གི་ཐོག་ལས་སྐྱེས་ཏེ་ཡོདཔ་ལས…

tells: Letters hanging from a top line
A small dot ་ between every syllable
Stacked consonants
items.blurb: The Tibetan script is a segmental writing system, or abugida, forming a part of the Brahmic scripts, and used to write certain Tibetic languages, including Tibetan, Dzongkha, Sikkimese, Ladakhi, Jirel and Balti.

items.name: Tifinagh

sample.text: ⴰⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵜⵍⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⵎⵉⴷⴷⵏ ⴳⴰⵏ ⵉⵍⴻⵍⵍⵉⵜⵏ ⵎⴳⴰⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⵖ ⵡⴰⴷⴷⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵔⴼⴰⵏ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⴰⴽⵯ ⴷⴰⵔⵙⵏ ⵓⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵓⴼⵔⴰⴽ, ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⴼⵍⵍⴰ ⵙⵏ ⴰⴷ…

tells: Geometric letters: circles, crosses, lines and dots
ⵣ (yaz) is the Amazigh symbol
Used for Berber in Morocco and Algeria
items.blurb: Tifinagh is a script used to write the Berber languages. It is descended from the ancient Libyco-Berber alphabet.
